blueprint.name: Find orphaned IBM Cloud resources (read-only)
blueprint.description: List the IBM Cloud resources a failed teardown stranded — jumphosts, security groups, floating IPs, subnets, VPCs, the Transit Gateway, the registry COS instance, the ROKS cluster and the BNK trusted profile — for one resource prefix. This blueprint DELETES NOTHING; it runs roksbnkctl's own `cleanup --dry-run`. Run it to find out what is still being paid for, then use 'Remove orphaned IBM Cloud resources' if the answer needs acting on.

outcomes: A list of every <prefix>-* resource roksbnkctl can find, in the order a teardown would remove them
Nothing created, nothing changed, nothing deleted

prerequisites.description: An IBM Cloud credential template on the project. Region and resource group inherit from it; the API key needs only read access for this blueprint.

input_summary.label: Keyed on the name prefix
input_summary.value: roksbnkctl sweeps for <prefix>-* and nothing else. That convention is the whole safety model: this account is shared, so 'orphan' means 'named like yours and left behind', not 'not in Forge'.

input_summary.label: Which regions
input_summary.value: The cluster and client regions recorded in the workspace. Resources stranded in another region are not seen — roksbnkctl has --all-regions for that, which this blueprint does not expose.

input_summary.label: Best effort
input_summary.value: It is a name-convention sweep, not a reconciliation against Forge's records. It will list a resource that matches the prefix even if a live Forge project still owns it, so read the list before acting on it.

required.name: prefix
required.label: Resource prefix to sweep
required.description: roksbnkctl's cleanup sweeps for resources named <prefix>-* and deletes them in dependency order. This prefix IS the safety boundary — it is the only thing separating your leftovers from the rest of a shared account that holds ROKS clusters across nine regions belonging to other teams. Use the prefix this catalog's blueprints deploy under.

required.name: region
required.label: IBM Cloud region
required.description: Region to sweep. Inherits from the selected credential template.

required.name: resource_group
required.label: Resource group
required.description: IBM Cloud resource group. Inherits from the selected credential template.

optional.name: ibmcloud_api_key
optional.label: IBM Cloud API key
optional.description: Filled from the project's credential template at creation.

modules.name: roksbnkctl Orphan Scan
modules.description: roksbnkctl cleanup --dry-run against the workspace prefix. Read-only.
